kuzu_graph.$comment: Graph memory (§4c). Owns its own kuzu database; no external daemon.

$comment: Stateless stdio proxy in front of the SnareVec daemon on 127.0.0.1:8756.
It is stdlib-only, so it needs no venv packages and starts regardless.
IMPORTANT: the daemon idles out and is restarted from the SnareVec
workbench. When it is down this server still connects and still lists
tools, but tool CALLS fail. That is a runtime condition, not a config
error - see TOOLS.md (§5a) for how the assistant should handle it.
Pixel-level GUI control. Runs in its OWN venv (mcps/UACC/.venv), not
the harness venv, because UACC is written against mcp v1 (FastMCP)
while the kuzu server needs mcp v2 (MCPServer). Those cannot coexist
in one interpreter. Separate processes can have separate Pythons -
which is exactly what the MCP boundary buys us, and it matches what
UACC's own uacc-mcp.bat already expects (it looks for %~dp0.venv).
MCP servers the harness launches as child processes and speaks stdio to.
This is the seam that makes the harness language-agnostic (§2): these are
all Python, the harness is Rust, and neither cares.
Paths are relative to the repo root unless absolute.
